[[File:Flamethrower-BtS.png|thumb|right|250px|[[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] using a wrist-mounted ZX miniature plame projector]]
A '''miniature flame projector''' was a smaller version of a [[Flamethrower/Legends|flamethrower]] that could be mounted on personal [[Armor/Legends|armor]]. [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Arms]] produced the [[ZX miniature flame projector/Legends|ZX miniature flame projector]] that [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] employed.
